method: Read all learner-visible fields and lexical objects of 32 quantity-scope and 16 quantity-zutsu tasks through lossless compact copies; re-read the truncated apple/budget records in full.

Read the six complete means-and-scope rank tasks; re-read the truncated final preference task. Read the six selected degree/polarity implication tasks and all nine complete approximation-versus-limit particle-neighbor tasks.

Read actual group/facet/member/context mappings, the linked quantity article through its relevant comparison, frequency, distribution, degree and part/remainder sections, and the source/classification contracts.

Searched existing Grammar objects for 倍, ratio/fraction and exact numeric-uncertainty/以内/ぶり forms. Search results identify candidate gaps; the complete-task comparisons establish the operation differences.
This is an author reuse/gap audit, not another independent linguistic certification of the unchanged baseline or a claim to read every unrelated task in means-and-scope and degree-and-polarity.

reuseConclusions.operations: Inclusive/strict boundaries, lower benchmark versus indefinite quantity, complete frequency formation, negative quantity scope, required resources versus price/activity duration.
reuseConclusions.limit: These do not already assess exact 以内, ratio order/base, 数十/十数, non-interrogative large magnitude or interval-before-repeat.

reuseConclusions.operations: Requested part versus remainder, both a fractional container quantity and a reduction from a stated regular price.
reuseConclusions.decision: Reuse all four unchanged. A recipe-water noun substitution would not add a third independent operation or justify new tasks just to match a planned key.

reuseConclusions.operations: Per-unit versus total for allocation/repeated days/entry groups; timing implications, small increments versus final total, completed incremental work and repeated timer adjustments.
reuseConclusions.decision: Preserve all objects, levels, groups and gates. Do not add numerical noun substitutions or duplicate increase-versus-final/total questions.

reuseConclusions.operations: Comparison-set boundary, non-first rank anchor and preference versus physical position.
reuseConclusions.decision: Reuse rather than introduce another ordinal/rank Grammar set; C4 separately supplies canonical numerical-unit reading/production.

reuseConclusions.operations: Near-whole membership does not prove everyone, near-zero sleep does not prove zero, and near-complete work does not prove exactly ninety percent.
reuseConclusions.decision: Do not duplicate general degree/precision implications. Exact 数十/十数/何百 magnitude interpretation is a different missing target.

reuseConclusions.operations: Selecting approximation versus an expressly requested exclusive limit in quantity frames.
reuseConclusions.limit: These are formation/selection operations, not a supplied-report inference test for every vague numeral. Four other N3 items in the same relationship remain unchanged and do not become new N5 coverage.

allocations.forms: 秒, 分秒 and manageable sub-minute durations
allocations.misconception: Seconds are not minutes; a component is not the entire duration.
allocations.support: Group time; explicit duration notation, no stopwatch locale ambiguity.
allocations.pilotEvidenceLimits: Accepted pilot members, not completion of every allocated row operation/context. Count once in the owning final batch.

allocations.forms: Age/year 代/年代, numerical 台 bands and 世紀
allocations.misconception: A band is not an exact value; a numbered century is not an arbitrary hundred-year span.
allocations.support: Existing words/世紀.md entry 1373990 inspected. State conventional notation, and keep calendar versus everyday group placement explicit.

allocations.forms: リットル/ミリリットル and metric トン
allocations.misconception: Metric ton is 1000 kg, not 1000 tons; rare 屯 is not the default writing.
allocations.support: Request the unit rather than require mental conversion; preserve easier g/kg drills.

allocations.forms: 時速/秒速 with ordinary metric units
allocations.misconception: Rate is not total distance; omitted everyday units depend on context.
allocations.support: State full units; avoid specialist technical reading variants.

allocations.forms: Part/whole, reduction amount and amount left
allocations.misconception: The removed part and remaining whole are different quantities.
allocations.support: Small transparent arithmetic; protect tested amount/construction from vocabulary gloss; per-task source level.
allocations.pilotEvidenceLimits: Accepted pilot members, not completion of every allocated row operation/context. Count once in the owning final batch.

allocations.forms: Ratio order, base and rate versus total
allocations.misconception: A ratio needs an ordered comparison and a rate does not supply an unstated total.
allocations.support: No complex arithmetic; exact whole-task level evidence rather than N3-by-project.

allocations.forms: 数十/十数; non-interrogative 何百-type magnitude; approximate versus established amount
allocations.misconception: A vague report does not establish an exact number; 十数 is not 数十.
allocations.support: Avoid disputed edge boundaries and answer-leaking glosses; classify actual tested construction.

allocations.misconception: 以内 includes the boundary, unlike a strict below/before reading; the counted unit remains explicit.
allocations.support: Existing bounds owner with additive facets only if needed; exact whole-task level source must be inspected.

allocations.forms: 年ぶり and month/year interval before a repeated event
allocations.misconception: A gap before a repeated event is not the event duration or a calendar year label.
allocations.support: D authors bounded counter expressions and existing time-frame interpretations, not a new Grammar engine. Verify exact Bunpro placement before assigning a Grammar level.

allocations.forms: 平方メートル, 畳/じょう and 坪 in stated housing area
allocations.misconception: Area, room count and floor/room identifiers differ; do not assert one exact universal physical tatami size.
allocations.support: Bounded production/reading of stated measurements, not land surveying or exact traditional-to-metric conversions.

allocations.misconception: Volume is not an invariant mass or cooked yield; a rice measuring cup is not automatically an ordinary cup.
allocations.support: Ordinary cooking quantities only; independently verify the practical use and any conversion before authoring.

allocations.forms: 大さじ/小さじ and simple fractional cooking measures
allocations.misconception: Named measuring units are not arbitrary household spoons; retain the requested measure and fraction.
allocations.support: Practical cooking inclusion, not medicinal dosing. The listed general sources motivate the gap; an exact cooking reference is required before this row can be covered.

proposedPackets.constraints: Existing v2 only; include two seconds pilot records once. Exact new numeral readings still need authoring checks and independent review; do not imply every planned expression is already verified.

Reuse the four fraction/discount pilots. Add only ratio order/base/rate implications, exact numeric uncertainty, within-boundary readings and a policy-resolved interval target. Preserve old Grammar objects and review statuses; existing quantity owner/chapter and no new hard gates.

sources.limit: Do not relabel scored Grammar interpretation as N3 or unclassified to meet this project's title. The unrelated appearance/style sense is not the target.

sources.inspected: Entire extracted measurement lesson through the final historical example.

sources.limit: Mixed specialist survey, not a frequency ranking. Repeated tables, a universal tatami conversion and source typos are not adopted. Exact new compound readings need targeted checks.

unresolved.evidence: Exact primary Bunpro lesson and index classify the intended ぶり lapse-of-time construction as N2. The subsequent actual Nonbiri and Edew teaching entries explicitly place the same temporal sense at N3; this is not confusion with appearance/style ぶり.
unresolved.userDirection: N2 is an allowed fallback if N3 or easier cannot be confirmed; do not rewrite that conditional direction as unconditional approval.
unresolved.recommended: The existing Bunpro-first policy retains N2 while documenting the verified N3 alternatives. Keep Counter expressions separate from interpretation. A scoped N3 exception or an N2 companion outside N3 coverage must be explicit; do not claim no N3 evidence exists, silently change the policy, delete the required row, or call N2 practice N3.
